crossRefs.note: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
